title: Wire phase 3 shadow observations into SOP evidence
user_business_goal: While waiting for live camera hardware, make Phase 3 SOP evidence more useful by routing sanitized detector observations into the Phase 3 shadow decision result instead of only returning generic safe fallback evidence.
out_of_scope: raw media, raw datasets, customer/factory data, notebooks, model weights, TensorRT engines, model binaries, or model execution
live camera capture, camera SDK loading, camera credentials, GPU/hardware validation, or hardware readiness approval
request-supplied file paths for replay/spec/calibration/model selection
production deploy/release, secrets, tokens, provider credentials, destructive migrations, production data migration, billing, legal/compliance behavior, or security boundary change
product spec approval, QC/SOP tolerance approval, model promotion approval, production PASS/NG authority, or production auto-reject behavior
acceptance_criteria: Add a Phase 3 shadow evaluator that accepts sanitized DetectorObservation entries.
When no observations are available, Phase 3 returns NOT_EVALUATED with MODEL_MISSING, no production authority, and model approval blockers.

When relevant observations are available, Phase 3 returns ASSIST with MODEL_REVIEW_REQUIRED, no production authority, and evidence including rule id, labels, confidence, bbox, model/evidence refs when present.
Phase 3 never returns PASS or NG and never grants production authority.
No-camera replay uses the Phase 3 shadow evaluator from replay frame detector_observations metadata.
HMI/replay payloads still include ordered Phase 1 through Phase 4 results and remain fail-closed/shadow-only.
Docs/tests describe the Phase 3 observation-evidence lane without approving model promotion, live inference, live camera capture, product specs, QC/SOP tolerances, or production release.
required_checks: HTTP preview smoke for /inspection/replay when local preview is available

memory_preflight.query: FQV2 phase 3 shadow observation evidence while camera hardware is pending.
retrieved_decisions: Detector observations cannot decide final PASS/NG.
retrieved_lessons: HMI should show actionable suspected regions from sanitized observations, but production authority remains false until QC/SOP/model approvals.
Phase 3 can consume replay observation metadata before live camera hardware arrives.
memory_preflight.conflicts_found: runtime/Windmill daily attention is separate; this task does not require Windmill secret access.

rollback_note: Revert the FQV2-051 PR to restore Phase 3 to generic safe fallback evidence only. Existing Phase 1/2 measurement logic, HMI signal layout, replay, detector bridge, and product CI behavior remain valid.
